title: Build the reproducible snapshot/boot benchmark harness and Docker comparison

test_results.output_excerpt: lib unit: 53 passed | blocked_lane integration: 6 passed | percentiles integration: 8 passed | result_schema integration: 6 passed | target_metadata integration: 4 passed | 77 total, 0 failed

verification.cargo_test: pass (cargo test -p microvm-bench: 77 tests, 0 failures; cargo build --workspace clean, confirming the additive workspace member and schema extension broke nothing)
verification.blocked_lane_manual_run: cargo run -p microvm-bench -- snapshot-restore --samples 100 --out .omo/evidence/kvm-microvm-orchestrator/task-27-benchmark.json -> exit 77; both lanes blocked (snapshot_restore=firecracker_missing, docker_start_cold=docker_missing) with cold.samples=warm.samples=0, null p50/p95/p99, and real host metadata (kvm_api_version=12, cgroup_v2=true, nested=true). No fabricated samples.

acceptance_criteria.benchmark_json_contains_hashes_versions_: BenchmarkResult (src/result.rs) serializes class='benchmark', host_metadata (cpu, kernel, kvm_api_version, page_cache_state, memory_size_mib, vcpu_count, cgroup_v2, nested), workload (name + payload_sha256 + optional kernel/rootfs/image hashes), runtime_versions (firecracker/docker; kernel version is host_metadata.kernel), and benchmarks[] (name, target_ms, unit, p50/p95/p99, cold/warm distributions with samples+failures+p50/p95/p99+min_ms+max_ms, blocked_reason). tests/result_schema.rs::harness_produced_result_satisfies_the_schema and committed_example_fixture_satisfies_the_schema hand-encode every schema invariant (additionalProperties:false, required keys, enums, hex pattern, blocked=>zero-samples+nulls) and validate both the committed example and harness output. committed_json_schema_document_is_well_formed asserts the schema requires workload+runtime_versions and keeps the explicit no-pass rule.
acceptance_criteria.docker_and_vm_use_same_pinned_payload_ha: config.rs holds exactly one Workload with a single payload_sha256; main.rs builds one Workload (default = SHA-256 of DEFAULT_PAYLOAD, or --payload-hash) and passes it to BOTH the FirecrackerSnapshotLane and DockerStartLane. The payload hash is recorded in the output workload.payload_sha256 so a reviewer verifies both lanes used identical bytes. config::workload_serializes_payload_and_optional_hashes and the schema's workload.payload_sha256 (^[0-9a-f]{64}$) enforce the pinned hash.
acceptance_criteria.target_is_metadata_never_a_pass_field: result.rs BenchmarkItem carries target_ms as a plain number; there is no pass field or verdict accessor anywhere. The schema forbids `pass` at top level and per item via additionalProperties:false + not:{required:['pass']}. tests/target_metadata.rs::samples_exceeding_target_produce_no_pass_field runs samples far above the 200ms target and recursively asserts no 'pass'/'passed'/'meets_target'/'sla_met' key exists at any depth; target_is_not_a_threshold_accessor and full_result_tree_has_no_pass_at_any_depth reinforce it. SNAPSHOT_RESTORE_TARGET_MS=200.0 is documented as reference metadata (Firecracker publishes no universal restore SLA).
acceptance_criteria.unavailable_docker_kvm_lane_blocked_with: outcome.rs BlockedReason provides stable tokens (kvm_unavailable, docker_missing, firecracker_missing, page_cache_drop_unsupported, cgroup_unavailable, nested_unavailable, artifact_missing). host.rs firecracker_lane_block probes /dev/kvm (KVM_GET_API_VERSION ioctl, -1 when inaccessible) then the firecracker binary on PATH; docker_lane_block probes the docker binary + daemon version. A blocked probe yields BenchmarkItem::blocked (zero samples, null percentiles, recorded reason) — never fabricated samples. marker::blocked_lane_yields_zero_samples_and_reason, blocked_lane::blocked_lane_never_invokes_sampling (empty queues => 0 samples + 0 failures proves sampling was never attempted), and blocked_lane::blocked_result_serializes_with_reason_and_nulls cover this. The binary exits 77 (BenchExitCode::Blocked) when any lane is blocked.
acceptance_criteria.identical_workload_cold_warm_monotonic_N: runner.rs LaneRunner + marker.rs BenchMarker collect N cold and N warm samples per lane under a host-monotonic clock (phase.rs PhaseRecorder enforces monotonic phase timestamps; the real runners time with std::time::Instant). MIN_SAMPLES=100 (config.rs) encodes the N>=100 floor; the CLI defaults --samples 100 and warns below it. Sample failures are counted in Distribution.failures and excluded from statistics (percentiles.rs from_samples_with_failures), never zero-filled. percentiles.rs uses deterministic nearest-rank (rank=ceil(p/100*N)). Tests: percentiles::* (determinism, order-independence, monotonicity, textbook definition), marker::sample_failures_are_recorded_not_counted, marker::completed_lane_produces_cold_and_warm_distributions, phase::backwards_timestamp_is_rejected.
acceptance_criteria.no_single_number_or_different_content_as: The harness publishes full cold+warm distributions (p50/p95/p99 + min/max + sample/failure counts) for both lanes pinned to one payload hash; it emits no winner/verdict/superiority field. The summary printer (main.rs summarise) labels every target as '(metadata only)'. tests/target_metadata.rs asserts no verdict field exists; the single shared Workload guarantees the comparison is between identical content.

qa_scenario.happy: cargo run -p microvm-bench -- snapshot-restore --samples 100 --out .omo/evidence/kvm-microvm-orchestrator/task-27-benchmark.json. On a privileged host (firecracker+jailer+KVM+cgroup-v2 and a running Docker daemon, with prepared snapshot artifacts) the FirecrackerSnapshotLane restores a prepared snapshot (spawn->socket-ready->PUT /snapshot/load->PATCH /vm Resumed, timed monotonically) and the DockerStartLane runs the same pinned payload image, each producing N>=100 cold+warm samples summarised to p50/p95/p99; exit 0. The deterministic equivalent is tests/result_schema.rs::harness_produced_result_satisfies_the_schema, which drives a ScriptedLane with 100 cold + 100 warm samples through the real BenchMarker and validates the full schema.
qa_scenario.failure: Run without Docker or /dev/kvm: the binary probes prerequisites and blocks the affected lane with a stable reason, zero samples, and null percentiles, then exits 77. Reproduced on this host (firecracker binary absent, Docker daemon down, /dev/kvm present): snapshot_restore blocked=firecracker_missing, docker_start_cold blocked=docker_missing, cold.samples=warm.samples=0, all percentiles null, no fabricated samples, EXIT=77; the artifact records real host metadata (kvm_api_version=12, cgroup_v2=true, nested=true) and the pinned workload hash. Deterministic coverage: blocked_lane::blocked_lane_records_reason_and_zero_samples, blocked_lane_never_invokes_sampling, mixed_blocked_and_completed_lanes, blocked_result_serializes_with_reason_and_nulls, blocked_privileged_lane_maps_to_exit_77. Usage errors (samples=0, malformed --payload-hash) exit 2; the warm-http command is a reserved stub for todo 28 (exit 2).

key_types.BenchmarkConfig: config.rs: the single pinned Workload + samples (N, MIN_SAMPLES=100 floor with meets_minimum_samples()) + Conditions (cgroup_v2/nested/page_cache request). new() rejects samples==0 (InvalidResourceSpec).
key_types.Workload: config.rs: name + payload_sha256 (the ONE hash shared by Docker and VM lanes) + optional kernel/rootfs/image hashes. Serializes to the schema workload object; optional hashes are omitted when unset.
key_types.RuntimeVersions: config.rs: firecracker/docker version strings (Option), populated by host::probe_firecracker_version/probe_docker_version; absent runtimes are omitted. The kernel version is host_metadata.kernel.
key_types.Percentiles: percentiles.rs: p50/p95/p99 via deterministic nearest-rank (rank=ceil(p/100*N), clamped). compute() returns None for empty input; always returns observed samples; order-independent and monotonic in p.
key_types.Distribution: percentiles.rs: per-condition summary (samples, failures, p50/p95/p99, min_ms, max_ms). from_samples_with_failures records failed attempts separately and excludes them from statistics; empty()/all-failed => samples=0 with null stats (failures preserved).
key_types.BenchmarkResult: result.rs: class='benchmark' + HostMetadata + Workload + RuntimeVersions + Vec<BenchmarkItem>; conforms to evidence-benchmark.v1.json (BENCHMARK_SCHEMA_ID). to_json_pretty() writes the artifact; has_blocked_lane() drives the exit code. Deliberately has NO pass field or verdict method.
key_types.BenchmarkItem: result.rs: one named benchmark record (name, target_ms metadata, unit, headline p50/p95/p99 preferring warm then cold, cold/warm Distributions, blocked_reason). blocked() builds a zero-sample/null-percentile item with a recorded reason.
key_types.HostMetadata: result.rs/host.rs: cpu, kernel, kvm_api_version (-1 when /dev/kvm inaccessible), page_cache_state, memory_size_mib, vcpu_count, cgroup_v2, nested. host.rs HostProbe gathers these from configurable /proc,/sys,/dev/kvm,cgroup roots with graceful fallbacks (never lies about nested/cgroup-v2/KVM).
key_types.BenchMarker: marker.rs: drives Vec<Box<dyn LaneRunner>>; per lane probes availability (blocked => blocked item, never fabricated), then collects N cold + N warm samples recording failures separately, and assembles a BenchmarkResult. Generic over LaneRunner so the same orchestration drives ScriptedLane (tests) and the real Firecracker/Docker lanes (privileged host).
key_types.LaneOutcome: outcome.rs: Completed | Blocked{reason,detail} | Failed{detail}. This is an EXECUTION outcome (could the lane run), never a performance verdict; it maps to the serialized blocked_reason and is never emitted as a `pass` boolean.
key_types.BlockedReason: outcome.rs: stable snake_case tokens (kvm_unavailable, docker_missing, firecracker_missing, page_cache_drop_unsupported, cgroup_unavailable, nested_unavailable, artifact_missing) written verbatim to blocked_reason.
key_types.BenchExitCode: outcome.rs: Success=0, GeneralError=1, UsageError=2, Blocked=77 (automake skip convention). Stable contract; the binary maps a blocked privileged lane to 77, argument errors to 2, runtime/I-O errors to 1.
key_types.PhaseRecorder: phase.rs: ordered monotonic phase boundaries; record_at rejects any timestamp that moves backwards (InternalError); duration_ms/total_ms are non-negative by construction. Reuses microvm_metrics::Clock for timestamps.
key_types.FirecrackerSnapshotLane: runner/firecracker.rs: real restore lane reusing microvm_firecracker (TokioLauncher spawn, UdsSnapshotApi PUT /snapshot/load with MemBackend::file, PATCH /vm Resumed), timed with a host-monotonic Instant; probes KVM+firecracker binary+prepared artifacts and blocks with evidence when absent.
key_types.DockerStartLane: runner/docker.rs: real Docker lane running the pinned payload image via `docker run --rm` (off the async runtime via spawn_blocking), timed monotonically; blocks with docker_missing when the binary/daemon is unavailable.
